newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $250 mln loan for Brazil.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $250 mln loan for Brazil.

text.p: The World Bank has approved a $250 million loan to provide technical advice and help boost private-sector participation in Brazilian public services, the bank said on Friday.
The bank in a statement said the loan would fund part of a privatization program started in 1995.
"The main objective is to provide technical advice and assist in developing a regulatory framework to enhance the private-sector participation in the delivery of public services," it said.
